sentences.text: For a floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on 15 March 2026, the applicable rule is the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, and the earlier RBI pre-payment charge directions are no longer in force. [E3, E5, E7, R1, R2]
A Tier 3 UCB must not levy any pre-payment charges only for loans with sanctioned amount up to ₹50 lakh, and this loan is for ₹80 lakh. [E5]
For cases outside those specific limits, pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of the UCB. [E7]
So the documents do not give a blanket prohibition here, and the answer depends on the UCB’s approved policy. [E7]
